snippet.title: Have You Seen the Moon? - Full Playthrough | Early 2024 Alpha Build
snippet.description:
Archivist's Information:
"Have You Seen the Moon?" was a game that was being developed by two of my friends in early 2024, and as of now they've only released this build on itch.io and coinciding soundtrack on Bandcamp.

Links:
itch.io - https://jcrips.itch.io/have-you-seen-the-moon
Bandcamp - https://jaxxtingrand.bandcamp.com/album/have-you-seen-the-moon

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/TSD34bRjZU
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/haybombyt.com
Website: https://haybombyt.com
Main Channel: @PastelGreendusk
Second Channel: @PastelExtradusk
Music Channel: @PastelMusicdusk
Leftovers Channel: @PackYrSuitcases
